defects.description: Artifact SBOM tab reloaded indefinitely when SBOM and attestation endpoints returned no data, preventing the empty state from rendering.
defects.evidence: Fixed with an sbomLoaded guard in web/src/routes/artifacts/[id]/+page.svelte and covered by the no-attestation E2E test.

defects.description: PolicyRuleBuilder action buttons inside the policy create form defaulted to submit buttons, causing rule-builder interactions to submit and disable the outer form.
defects.evidence: Fixed by adding type="button" to non-submit buttons in web/src/lib/components/PolicyRuleBuilder.svelte and covered by SBOM rule-builder E2E tests.

defects.description: Broad browser E2E coverage does not yet drive a signer-first SBOM generate/import UI/control surface through ContextVM and observe 30315/4903/30078/30004 relay outcomes end-to-end.
defects.evidence: Current deterministic coverage proves the service, event builders, REST compatibility, MCP compatibility, and artifact/event UI slices. Broader browser E2E is tracked in Bead bahia-wf2k with acceptance criteria for injected EVENT/EOSE/OK behavior and no sleep/polling completion.

defects.description: SBOM storage tests only asserted hash mismatch failure and did not prove successful Blossom store, resolve, and payload verification in one deterministic path.
defects.evidence: Added TestStorageResolver_ResolveAndVerify to store exact payload bytes on the mock Blossom client, resolve by returned location, verify the attestation hash, and reject a mutated hash.

defects.description: SBOM orchestration projected manifests before publishing the canonical 30004 availability list, which inverted the design flow where relay observables are canonical and the database is a projection.
defects.evidence: bahia-1qe9.9 moved ProjectManifest until after accepted 30078 and 30004 publication, persists availability_event_id/availability_d_tag, and added TestSBOMOrchestratorGeneratePublishesProjectsAndAudits ordering assertions.

defects.description: REST compatibility SBOM ingest used io.LimitReader in a way that could silently truncate payloads larger than 10 MiB and import the truncated bytes.
defects.evidence: bahia-1qe9.9 rejects payloads larger than 10 MiB with HTTP 413 and TestIngestSBOMRejectsOversizedPayloadWithoutImport proves the import service is not called.

defects.description: The optional cdxgen adapter exists but is not wired into runtime app configuration, so operators cannot enable cdxgen-backed CycloneDX repository generation in production wiring.
defects.evidence: Tracked as Bead bahia-qfod with acceptance criteria for config fields, app wiring, deterministic tests, and PSTF/docs updates.

defects.description: ContextVM sbom/generate and sbom/import handlers currently return after synchronous orchestration completion; architecture needs an explicit decision documenting whether this is acceptable or should become immediate acknowledgment plus event-driven background completion.
defects.evidence: Tracked as Bead bahia-ilio with acceptance criteria to record HITL decision and either implement asynchronous ack semantics or document/test retained synchronous behavior while preserving terminal truth in 30078/30004.

defects.description: SBOM 30004 availability-list replacement currently merges local projection entries under a process-local subject lock, but does not yet subscribe to relay canonical history and merge valid entries from other Bahia instances before replacing the complete list.
defects.evidence: Tracked as Bead bahia-ndmr with acceptance criteria for scoped REQ, EVENT/EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH handling, signature/content validation, merge/dedupe, OK-verified publish, and deterministic tests without sleeps.
